mia_all_definition: Per-target official score_mia breakdown tpr_at_low_fpr at FPR=0.01, before max with rare TPR.
aia_definition: The existing official target AIA power after rare SE deadzone, max(all,rare), and target floor subtraction/clipping; unchanged.

separate_diagnostics.mia_rare_tpr: Official rare TPR per target; preserve undefined as null rather than zero.
separate_diagnostics.all_components: Retain per-target mia_all, mia_power, mia_rare, aia_power and positive/rare-positive counts.

retrospective_design_note: The stable indicator was proposed after observing reference-model reversals on v4. All three v4 worlds are retrospective design data and are not validation evidence for this new indicator.
case_selection: Run both reserved worlds once and retain all outcomes; no seed/model/official-feedback-based selection.
validation: Primary: compute each reference model stable_index in BOTH reserved confirmation cases, average those two case scores equally, and check all six strict known-reference pairwise directions. Missing cases fail completeness. A tie with absolute delta <= 1e-12 is not a hit. No case selection, weighting or refitting.
target_aggregation: All 22 targets equally weighted; no exclusions, weights, model-specific rules or fitted coefficients.
limitations: This is a separate candidate-order diagnostic, not the official contest score.
Suppressing rare MIA max uplift may hide real rare-person attack strength. Always show it separately.
New seeds reuse holdout donor rows, the same population construction and public profiles. They are scenario replications, not independent unseen people.
Passing two known-reference scenarios does not establish accuracy for unknown future models.
Public-profile coverage failures remain visible; no coverage gate is relaxed.
sensitivity_diagnostics: Show every individual case score, all six pair directions, rank and mismatch without requiring every case to match as the primary criterion.
Show each pair difference in both cases and its min/max range. This is a sensitivity range, not a confidence interval.

Leave the same target out of both cases, recompute each 21-target stable_index and its equal-case mean, and report all 22 resulting six-pair rank checks. Also show per-case leave-one-target-out results.
old_v4_gate_unchanged: The older v4 official-score all-case agreement gate remains unchanged. This new mean-first rule applies only to the separately frozen stable-index v5 hypothesis.
pre_generation_revision: Before any v5 case generation or new stable-index result: separate mean-rank primary criterion from case and target sensitivity diagnostics.
secondary_validation: Report whether each of the two individual cases matches all six pairs, the fraction of cases with all-six agreement, and the stronger both-cases-all-six flag separately from the mean-rank primary criterion.
